title: Causal DAG Identification for Count Data via Poisson Thinning Structural Equation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.06098v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Count-valued variables arise in many scientific and applied settings, yet explicit structural models that allow full identification of causal DAGs from observational data remain limited. The Poisson branching structural causal model (PB-SCM) provides a count-valued analogue of linear structural equation models using binomial thinning and independent Poisson exogenous variables, but its causal DAG is generally only partially identifiable.   Building on this framework, we propose the Poisson thinning structural equation model (PT-SEM), which replaces binomial thinning in PB-SCM with Poisson thinning and allows node-wise exogenous distributions from diverse count-distribution families. Under node-wise regularity conditions, we establish identifiability of the causal DAG, the thinning coefficients, and the node-wise exogenous distributions. The same identification analysis extends to binomial thinning, yielding full identifiability wheneve

translated_title: 基于泊松稀释结构方程模型的计数数据因果DAG识别
translated_abstract: 计数值变量出现在许多科学和应用场景中，然而能够从观测数据中完全识别因果DAG的显式结构模型仍然有限。泊松分支结构因果模型（PB-SCM）通过二项稀释和独立的泊松外生变量，为线性结构方程模型提供了计数值的类似物，但其因果DAG通常只能被部分识别。在此框架基础上，我们提出了泊松稀释结构方程模型（PT-SEM），该模型用泊松稀释替代PB-SCM中的二项稀释，并允许节点级外生分布来自多样化的计数分布族。在节点级正则性条件下，我们建立了因果DAG、稀释系数以及节点级外生分布的可识别性。相同的识别分析可以扩展到二项稀释情形，从而在某些条件下获得完全可识别性。
tldr: 提出泊松稀释结构方程模型（PT-SEM），通过泊松稀释机制和灵活的节点级外生分布设定，首次实现了从观测数据中对计数数据因果DAG、稀释系数及外生分布的完全识别。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Poisson thinning structural equation model (PT-SEM), which achieves full identifiability of causal DAGs, thinning coefficients, and exogenous distributions for count data by replacing binomial thinning with Poisson thinning under node-wise regularity conditions.
